summary: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a 6-K containing its response to multiple clarification requests from the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) regarding governance matters. The response details the roles of the newly established Legal and Compliance Directorate and Chief Integrity Officer, as well as a background on an SEC inquiry received in October 2023 related to Telkom Infra's involvement in a BAKTI Kominfo project. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situation event is announced; the filing is purely a regulatory update and clarification. As such, it does not constitute a special situation.
